tiles.title: Top Signatures (Last 7d)
tiles.description: Counts of top signature IDs aggregated across runs
tiles.query: SELECT sig_id, SUM(count) as total FROM signatures_top_7d GROUP BY sig_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

tiles.title: Dominant Components (Last 7d)
tiles.description: Distribution of dominant components across runs
tiles.query: SELECT component, COUNT(1) as total FROM dominant_components_7d GROUP BY component ORDER BY total DESC
